articles.author: Smart Logistics Global Ltd
articles.headline: Smart Logistics Global Limited Receives Additional 180-Day Nasdaq Compliance Period
articles.summary: The issuer reports an additional 180 calendar days, through April 26, 2027, to satisfy Nasdaq's minimum bid-price rule. The extension is not itself restored compliance and the issuer gives no assurance it will satisfy the requirement.
articles.timestampEvidence: Finviz reproduces the October 29 release at 16:15; the GlobeNewswire syndication at StreetInsider explicitly identifies 4:15 PM EDT. The SEC report corroborates the extension, without substituting its event date for the release time.
